audit: VERTEX Kattis candidate original-statement evidence ledger — pass 2
method: Original contest statement copies were inspected for title/problem identity, story, input/output, and constraints. This is statement evidence only; it does not independently verify the live Kattis page or qualify long-scenario depth.

records.title: Button Bashing
records.identity: title and problem B match; contest archive confirms the corresponding Kattis slug
records.observed: The statement defines a microwave timer with increment/decrement buttons, clamping at zero and one hour, and asks for the minimum presses to reach or exceed a target.
records.excerpt: You recently acquired a new microwave, and noticed that it provides a large number of buttons
records.inputOutput: Input: test cases, button count, target seconds, and signed time changes. Output: minimum button presses and smallest overshoot.
records.constraints: At most 100 test cases; up to 16 buttons; target up to 3,600 seconds; button changes between -3,600 and 3,600.
records.scenarioNotes: Concrete device-control framing with state clamping, but short, self-contained state-space problem. Long-scenario depth not approved.

records.title: Restaurant Orders
records.statementTitle: KTH Challenge 2012, Problem G — Restaurant Orders
records.identity: title and problem ID orders explicitly match
records.observed: A waiter must infer menu item combinations from order totals; the output distinguishes unique, impossible and ambiguous combinations.
records.excerpt: A friend of yours who is working as a waiter has a problem.
records.inputOutput: Input: menu item prices and order totals. Output: the item indices for a unique combination, Impossible, or Ambiguous.
records.constraints: Up to 100 menu items and 1,000 orders; individual prices up to 1,000 SEK and order totals up to 30,000 SEK.
records.scenarioNotes: Has a concrete waiter/menu setting and ambiguity handling, but the scenario is concise and the core task is bounded knapsack reconstruction. Long-scenario status not approved.
